method.name: resendFrom
method.signature: resendFrom(seq: number, newTurnId: string, windowKey: string): EnqueueResult
method.purpose: resend, with the message handed to the window that resends it: a not-delivered message is one whose window closed, so resending it under its old window key would leave it undeliverable again

body.rationale: store.resend (chat-queue-store.ts:415-432) re-inserts the row with old.windowKey. A not-delivered message (s3) is by definition one whose window is closed; the user resends it from another window showing the same chat, and under the old key no live window would ever take it, so s3 would mark it not-delivered again. resendFrom does the same single transaction with the resending window's key. Additive: resend stays.
